theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_differentiated_system
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ x P) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 v U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ∃ Ψ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, Ψ x P = fderiv ℝ (fun z => Φ z P) x e - fderiv ℝ (fun z => a z (fderiv ℝ v x) P) x e) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ v z e) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Ψ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
